name: Suddenly My Stepsister!?
source: Our protagonist has done his best to try and gain the attention of the school’s most popular girl, but in the process, he’s broken the heart of a classmate that he deemed as 'boring.' However, when his mother remarries, he now has an incredibly cute stepsister who turns out to be that boring girl he wasn’t interested in! Why is she hiding her true identity?
translation: 我们的主角竭尽全力试图吸引学校最受欢迎女孩的注意，但在这个过程中，他伤了一位他认为“无聊”的同学的心。然而，当他的母亲再婚时，他现在有了一个非常可爱的继姐妹，而她原来是那个他不感兴趣的无聊女孩！她为何要隐藏自己的真实身份？
